On August 30, 2019, Oregon & Southern Idaho District Council of Laborers and LIUNA Local 737 (Local 737), filed a unit clarification petition under ORS 243.682(2)(a) and OAR 115-025-0005(7). Local 737 represents an existing unit of Medford Water Commission (Commission) employees in the classifications of Utility Personnel I, II, III and IV, and Field Technician. Local 737 petitioned to add to that unit all full-time and regular part-time Commission employees in the Engineering Department, Operations Department, and Administration Department, excluding supervisory and confidential positions. A majority of eligible employees specified in the petition signed valid authorization cards designating Local 737 as the exclusive bargaining representative.
On September 4, 2019, the Board’s Election Coordinator caused a notice of the petition to be posted at the Commission by September 6, 2019. OAR 115-025-0030(3); OAR 115-025-0065. Pursuant to the terms of the notice posting, OAR 115-025-0030(3)(d), OAR 115-025-0065(7), and OAR 115-025-0075(2), objections to the proposed bargaining unit or a request for an election were due within 14 days of the date of the notice posting (i.e., by September 20, 2019).
On September 16, 2019, certain unrepresented employees in the petitioned-for unit filed a petition to hold an election under ORS 243.682(3), OAR 115-025-0005(7)(c), and OAR 115-025-0075(2).1 The petition was supported by a sufficient showing of interest. ORS 243.682(3)(b); OAR 115-025-0075(2).
1On September 17, 2019, the Commission filed objections to the petition, but it subsequently withdrew them. 2
Thereafter, the parties entered into a consent election agreement. Pursuant to that agreement, the Election Coordinator sent ballots to eligible voters on October 28, 2019. Twenty-nine valid ballots were returned by the deadline of November 12, 2019, which constitutes the date of the election. See OAR 115-025-0075(5); OAR 115-025-0060(4)(c). The two choices on the ballot were (1) representation by Oregon & Southern Idaho District Council of Laborers and LIUNA Local 737; or (2) No Representation. A tally of ballots was held on November 13, 2019, and the majority of valid votes counted were cast for No Representation. The tally of ballots was provided to the parties on November 13, 2019.
Objections to the conduct of the election (or conduct affecting the results of the election) were due within ten days of the date that the ballot tally was furnished to the parties (i.e., by November 25, 2019). OAR 115-025-0075(5); OAR 115-025-0060(9). No objections were filed.
ORDER
The result of the election is certified, and Local 737’s petition to add unrepresented employees (described above) to its existing bargaining unit is dismissed.
DATED: November 26, 2019.
